description.en: The information about the associated Elasticsearch instance.

description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A unique token used to ensure idempotence of the request. The client generates this value. The value must be unique across different requests and can contain up to 64 ASCII characters.

descriptions.zh: > 管道管理方式分为配置文件管理和Kibana管道管理，目前控制台已不支持Kibana管道管理，仅可通过API使用此功能。
descriptions.en: > Pipeline management methods include configuration file management and Kibana pipeline management. The console no longer supports Kibana pipeline management. You can use this feature only through the API.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch update-pipeline-management-config --instance-id ls-cn-oew1qbgl0000 --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF0000 --endpoints http://es-cn-n6w1o1x0w001c0000.elasticsearch.aliyuncs.com:9200 --user-name elastic --password xxxx --pipeline-ids testKibanaManagement --pipeline-management-type ES --es-instance-id es-cn-n6w1o1x0w001c0000 --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
